data.name: Adaia
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Adaia, meaning 'just', 'righteous', or 'noble'. In Greek mythology, Adaia was a goddess of justice. In Christianity, Adaia is a name for the Holy Spirit, symbolizing righteousness and justice.

in_hebrew.name: עֲדָיָא
in_hebrew.meaning: תְּעוּדָה שֶׁל ה', צְדָקָה, חֶסֶד, וְאַהֲבָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עֲדָיָא היא שְׁמוֹ שֶׁמְצוּי בְּתוֹרָה, וּמַשְׁמְעוֹתָיו רְבֵיבָן. בְּעֵת הַתְּמוּנָה, עֲדָיָא היא תְּעוּדָה שֶׁל ה' בְּיוֹם ה' - שֶׁהוּא יוֹם הַיְשֻׁעָה. כָּל בְּנֵי-אָדָם, שֶׁבָּאוּ לְיָחִיד, נִקְרָאוּ בְּשֵׁם זֶה, כְּדֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁמָר הַתָּמִידִי, שֶׁהוּא שָׁם, הִתְעַצְּמוּ, וְקָרְבוּ, לְקָדוֹשׁ-בָּרוּךְ-הוּא.

in_greek.name: Ἀδαιά
in_greek.meaning: ἡμέρα τοῦ Κυρίου, χάρις, ελεημοσύνη, και ἀγάπη
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ ὄνομα Ἀδαιά ἀπαντάται στὴν Παλαιὰ Διαθήκη, ὡς ὀνοματοδοσία τοῦ ἱεροῦ ἄγαλματος τοῦ Θεοῦ. Ἀδαιά ἐστὶ ἡμέρα τοῦ Κυρίου, ἡμέρα ἐν ᾗ ὁ Θεὸς φωνάζει στὰ ἔθνη, ἀνακηρύττοντας τὴν ἀλήθεια καὶ τὴν εὐλογία. Ἡ ἀπάντηση τοῦ Ἀδαιά εἶναι ἡ ἀγάπη, ἡ εὐλογία, καὶ ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ. Ἐπὶ τῶν αἰώνων!

in_latin.name: Adaia
in_latin.meaning: Dies Domini, gratia, caritas, et amor
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Adaia apparit in Veteri Testamento, ut nomen dedicatum sanctae imaginis Dei. Adaia est Dies Domini, Dies in quo Deus clamat gentibus, annuntians veritatem et benedictionem. Respondere Adaia est caritas, gratia, et amor Dei. In saecula saeculorum!

in_english.name: Adaia
in_english.meaning: Day of the Lord, grace, charity, and love
in_english.long_meaning: The name Adaia appears in the Old Testament, as a dedication name for the holy image of God. Adaia is the Day of the Lord, the day in which God calls out to the nations, announcing truth and blessing. The response to Adaia is love, grace, and the love of God. Through the ages!

biblical_reference.note: The name Adaia is associated with the holy image of God in Ezekiel 43:1-12.

data.cultural_impact: The name Adaia carries a strong sense of fairness and justice from its Greek origins. This cultural significance has carried over into Christianity, where Adaia is a name for the Holy Spirit that represents righteousness, justice, and fairness in the divine realm.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Adaia embodies the divine qualities of justice and righteousness, as well as nobility and virtue. It is a powerful reminder of the importance of living in accordance with God's laws and seeking justice and fairness for all people. The name Adaia inspires us to strive for holiness and to live a life that reflects the divine qualities of justice and righteousness.
